entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that serves as a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and automated fact extraction. It provides hybrid RAG and memory search with connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes context using a virtual filesystem with viking:// URIs. It utilizes tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token consumption and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that extracts entity relationships without requiring LLM calls. It provides synthesized answers with citations and supports multi-user institutional memory with scoped data access.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system for agents that supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It offers Python and Node.js client SDKs and acts as an LLM wrapper for existing agents.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that provides a FastAPI server for managed or self-hosted use. It supports Python and TypeScript client SDKs and offers hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control (commit, branch, and merge). It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context using local infrastructure like Qdrant and Redis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness designed to help agents succeed on complex tasks. It supports multiple providers and provides filesystem-based traces, reports, and playbooks via Python and TypeScript CLI surfaces.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based context engine to prevent message loss. It utilizes a SQLite-backed message store to build depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted Honcho memory backend that enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers via a Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis setup.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store human-readable data on local disks for multi-agent systems. It supports hybrid search stacks and integrates with tools like Claude Code and Cursor via MCP.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25 and vector search to serve agents through MCP and dedicated plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference by using block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem and can save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that relies on SQLite with FTS5 search rather than vector databases or embeddings. The project features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recalled memory. It supports an in-process embedded mode and includes a self-directing loop to identify and address knowledge gaps.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack functions as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes agents. It manages state and retrieval using a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver evidence packets for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Developed for the Hermes 2026 Hackathon, this project features an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server for automated configuration.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between stored notes. It supports automated indexing for codebases and multimedia via OCR, utilizing both BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace states into verified facts to ensure agents only load necessary context, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It renders these facts into files like AGENTS.md and pairs with Perseus Vault for encrypted semantic recall.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth, storing data in inspectable Markdown files. It operates without a daemon or opaque databases, utilizing DuckDB solely as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides an audit trace of all prefetch operations through a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates directly with Hermes to facilitate automated payments.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local capabilities such as scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations. It provides tools for knowledge search and usage reporting, with an option for automatic tool-routing note generation via model calls.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, featuring configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon. It offers HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall with MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search method combining BM25, vector, and graph techniques, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It enables grounded Q&A that includes specific file-and-line citations while running locally over localhost.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven methodology for engineering tasks rooted in TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development system compatible with harnesses like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system enables agents to generate brand-aligned visual assets including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It supports OpenAI-compatible endpoints and provides a dedicated CLI for Hermes Agent integration.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a memory platform that builds self-hosted knowledge graphs from any data format to provide agents with persistent long-term memory. It offers dedicated clients for both Rust and TypeScript environments.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains, mapped to industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. The collection is compatible with over 26 AI platforms for specialized security operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram type presets. It features built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities and can convert Mermaid text into diagram formats.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Designed for Hermes and Claude Code, this tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It utilizes a two-pass detection process and a 112-entry word replacement table to refine output.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce by providing adjudication, escrow, and dispute resolution services. it integrates natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions to connect fragmented ecosystem layers.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw automates the evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement of agentic capabilities across multiple devices. It integrates with Hermes and OpenClaw to unify and collectively advance skill sets.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library offers 12 metaskills that preserve state within a local docs folder for agentskills.io-compatible agents. The skills are available as spec-conformant plugins designed for use with Claude Code.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,099 professional skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It also provides ready-to-paste exports to facilitate the use of these skills in other AI assistants.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage new skills via slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Powered by TranscriptAPI, this tool provides Hermes Agent with the ability to search YouTube and retrieve data from transcripts, channels, and playlists. It is fully compatible with the standard Agent Skills format used by OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It provides a report of analysis blind spots alongside its findings.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents using a three-level work model. It provides structured memory via file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for task and card management.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This repository provides skills for interacting with smart contracts and oracle networks, including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It follows the Agent Skills specification for interoperability and includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides skills in SKILL.md format along with installation and configuration guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX.2 and FLUX.1 models. It includes code examples and a suite of six specialized FLUX 3 video skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool extracts function signatures and types from code and documentation to create agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides version-pinned skills with an audit trail.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It features real-time tracking of progress and decisions alongside built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This workflow language provides intent as code through a single Rust binary and four verbs. It enables local-first execution with any LLM and provides static auditing via nika check alongside tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval system uses a five-layer approach involving hard triggers, synonyms, and dense embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It utilizes RRF fusion and provides graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This tool performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews by using three parallel subagents to attack code from different angles. It verifies findings via sandbox execution and includes a deterministic pre-scan using multiple static analysis tools.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation by implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model family and tracks quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution OS manages habits and study blocks using local SQLite storage with no cloud sync. It connects to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses three parallel sub-agents—Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness—to perform multi-agent code simplification. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust through a tiered application process with an approval gate.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network, forensics, and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This project automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This tool provides functional quality certification for AI agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker environments. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates structured Chinese news briefings across multiple geographic scales, ranging from global to street level. It produces reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory for search expansion.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides video-to-text transcription, local OCR for PDFs and images, and batch e-commerce material generation. It includes specialized functions such as AI text de-humanization and brand overlays for e-commerce assets.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This repository provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This project offers scripts and configuration guides for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for the Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android and utilizes Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and UI access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository provides a Termux-based installer and guide for deploying Hermes Agent on Android devices using proot-distro. The setup supports local models via Ollama and is compatible with multiple AI model providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables Kubernetes deployment of Hermes Agent with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD-based workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer facilitates Hermes AI assistant deployment on both Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH). It features Telegram integration for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing using NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding web search and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration of workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is designed to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, LLM budget caps, and costs via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane used to run and operate multiple Hermes Agent instances through a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities while providing task scheduling and hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project provides a production-ready, headless systemd deployment for Hermes Agent on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable Hermes Agent runs from a USB or any drive without requiring host system installation. It supports Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes simultaneously and includes bundled Python 3.12 and Sysinternals rescue tools.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multi-agent LLM financial trading, incorporating fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It facilitates structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers and supports Docker deployment.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers container sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system features a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis. It is designed for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs using Hermes and Ollama without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It runs entirely locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux, featuring an auto-sync capability to keep the graph current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It offers a 3D visualization dashboard and supports data submission for public profiles and leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer designed to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes Agent and Cursor. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions and automatically redacts authentication headers to ensure security.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget monitors real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of agents like Hermes and Claude Code. It supports real-time data synchronization across multiple machines to track account limits and session details.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for building and operating applications. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This community-driven project offers CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can create custom aesthetics, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk, using YAML-based configurations for banners, colors, and spinners.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments alongside human-readable identity handles.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control through MCP, supporting providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It features a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and an undo function for recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory tools and integrations for frameworks such as CrewAI and LangGraph across platforms like Slack and VS Code. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup uses RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, supported by an automated cross-platform installer.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while managing project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services at zero cost using free models. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories to get a production-ready stack running in minutes.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed to validate AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It identifies overlapping tool descriptions, inconsistent schemas, and missing stop conditions through local execution or CI/CD integrations.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: A fully local, voice-enabled assistant for Hermes Agent that supports 35 languages and requires no API keys or accounts. It features an open mic with wake-word detection, adaptive turn-taking, and barge-in capabilities for offline interaction.

entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that provides a unified interface for various agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent and OpenClaw. It supports remote access through WebUI, Telegram, Lark, DingTalk, and WeChat, and includes 21 built-in professional assistants.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface built with Python and vanilla JS designed for accessing Hermes Agent via a browser or SSH tunnel. It features workspace file browsing with inline preview capabilities.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to assist with the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent and its providers. It offers a GUI for managing chats, sessions, and tools.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard that supports multi-platform AI chat with streaming responses and tool traces. It includes visual workflow building, Kanban boards, usage analytics, and channel configuration for 10 platforms including Telegram, Discord, and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and other agents. It is available as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container and includes native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for shell access.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows and macOS desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It features a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local execution and includes UI for MCP tools, memory management, and LaTeX/Mermaid rendering.

entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.

It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that provides analytics and limits tracking for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It offers searchable history with transcript inspection, image browsing, and live per-session quota burn-rates for Codex and Claude.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace is designed for Hermes Agent running on Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative TUI and dashboard allows users to chat with and manage Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: This self-hostable dashboard template pairs with local Hermes agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests that involve side effects.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses, file attachments, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop version of Hermes Agent that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent that provides real-time log streaming and chat. The interface includes an integrated file browser and a dashboard for tracking tasks, skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard provides real-time process monitoring for Hermes, including session activity and cost tracking. Users can perform full inspection of conversation histories, skill source code, and read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a PM orchestrator.
